"'''The Shadow of Umbara'''" is a short story that was published in the anthology ''[[The Clone Wars: Stories of Light and Dark]]'', adapting the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episodes "[[Darkness on Umbara]]," "[[The General (episode)|The General]]," "[[Plan of Dissent]]," and "[[Carnage of Krell]]." It was written by [[Yoon Ha Lee]], and published on [[August 25]], [[2020]] by [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]].
